items.period: Shang (file is labeled Shang oracle-script style; not an artifact date)
items.tradition: Oracle-bone script style; modern vector redraw
items.caption: Modern redraw labeled as 比 in Shang oracle-script style, based on Hanziyuan image j19532. It records one proposed early form; it is not an oracle-bone photograph and does not settle the sign’s origin.
items.alt: A modern vector redraw of a form labeled 比 in Shang oracle-script style.
items.selection_reason: Provides a labeled early-form example relevant to the article’s discussion of disputed early graph analysis; the caption explicitly distinguishes redraw from artifact and avoids asserting the disputed referent.
items.rights: Commons marks the SVG representation public domain; its file page records source-model attribution to Hanziyuan and permission provenance.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script style (Han dictionary tradition; the SVG itself was uploaded in 2009)
items.caption: Modern vector drawing of 比 in Shuowen seal-script style, based on Hanziyuan image s05946. It illustrates a later dictionary-form tradition, not an excavated seal inscription.
items.alt: A modern vector redraw of 比 in Shuowen seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: Offers a distinct, explicitly labeled later script-style comparison with the oracle-style redraw while clarifying that both are modern representations.
items.rights: Commons marks the SVG representation public domain; its file page records source-model attribution to Hanziyuan and permission provenance.

limitations.text: Both candidates are modern vector redraws. Their labels and source-model links make them useful as form examples, but neither is a photograph of an ancient artifact or independent evidence for the disputed component analysis. Pixel inspection was not available through the browser.
